THE BLEND, LIVE

The puck's dashed lines to each corner are drawn at that corner's actual weight — heaviest line is where the puck is closest.

The callout below is not on the real screen; it's this board's own addition, translating the four percentages into the four macro values they actually produce (pitch/cutoff/resonance/drive), which the real app never shows in one place.

HOW SET A WORKS

The two-step capture flow: find a sound in XY, tap SET A, and that exact sound becomes corner A's new preset. Step 3 shows the state after two of four corners are captured — C and D still hold the factory defaults until you do the same for them.
